_readme: Extends evaluation/evaluate_multi_agent.py's original 10 cases with: Agent System B routing/tool cases, per-tool tool-selection ground truth, fact checklists for task completion, and minimum_steps for step-efficiency. Modeled on Session 11 Part 5's harness (routing accuracy as a confusion matrix, tool accuracy split into name+args, in-order trajectory match, fact-checklist task completion, step efficiency).
